visual_identity.core_identity: A small, wiry, scrappy goblinoid scavenger: ugly-cunning rather than cute, with quick hands, oversized pointed ears, a broad flattened nose, angular cheeks, and a wide sharp-toothed grin.
visual_identity.silhouette: Small narrow torso, thin limbs, slightly hunched or darting posture, oversized pointed ears, large quick hands and feet; sparse scalp hair at most, never a furry outline.
visual_identity.head_features: Oversized pointed ears; broad flattened goblinoid nose; angular cheekbones; low brow; sharp chin; wide mouth with irregular small teeth; lively predatory eyes. The face must not resemble an elf child, imp, devil, or furry gremlin.
visual_identity.body_shape: Small narrow-chested humanoid with lean sinewy limbs, long quick fingers, slightly crouched posture, and light scavenger proportions rather than heroic or muscular anatomy.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly bare leathery-looking skin represented with clean line art; sparse hair only. No fur covering, fluffy cheeks, fuzzy limbs, or animal pelt silhouette.
signature_gear: small scavenged knife or simple hand tool

accuracy_checks: oversized pointed ears dominate the silhouette
broad flattened nose and angular face read as goblin rather than imp, elf, or kobold
body is small, wiry, and slightly hunched or darting
skin silhouette is not furry or fluffy
gear and clothing look scavenged rather than neat
pose reads sneaky, opportunistic, or quick

reference.notes: Reference guides goblin silhouette and facial anatomy only.
